name: AnalystOS
description: An analyst team that takes a question and its source documents and returns a sealed report in which every figure is a verified quote or an independently recomputed calculation.

roles.name: coordination
roles.purpose: Accepts each engagement, assigns its work to a role, and is where every role escalates.
roles.measure: Engagements delivered by the date agreed at acceptance, as a share of engagements accepted

roles.name: research
roles.purpose: Gathers the source documents an engagement needs and records where each one came from.
roles.measure: Sources in a delivered report with a recorded origin, as a share of sources used

roles.name: analysis
roles.purpose: Reads one source document and drafts a cited report from verified facts only.
roles.measure: Reports delivered at the written tier, with both quality gates passed, as a share of reports delivered

roles.name: verification
roles.purpose: Recomputes every calculation and refuses any figure it cannot prove against the source.
roles.measure: Facts refused for failing verification, as a share of facts proposed

roles.name: synthesis
roles.purpose: Combines verified single-document reports into cross-document findings without adding an unverified figure.
roles.measure: Findings in a delivered synthesis traceable to a verified fact, as a share of findings stated

roles.name: evidence
roles.purpose: Seals each delivered report so a stranger can re-verify it offline.
roles.measure: Delivered reports whose seal re-verifies offline, as a share of reports delivered

roles.name: client-delivery
roles.purpose: Hands the sealed report to the client, walks them through it, and logs every question it raises.
roles.measure: Client questions answered from the sealed report without a reissue, as a share of questions asked
